facts.fact: The AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Act, 2026 made Amaravati the sole capital of Andhra Pradesh.
The Amendment Act received Presidential assent on 6 April 2026.
It amended Section 5(2) of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014.
Sole-capital status ended the earlier 'three capitals' policy (Amaravati, Visakhapatnam, Kurnool).
The Amaravati Quantum Valley Tech Park partners are IBM, TCS and IIT Madras.
Polavaram's new diaphragm wall was completed on 2 April 2026.
After the wall, works on the Earth-Cum-Rock-Fill (ECRF) dam began.
The original diaphragm wall had been damaged by Godavari floods.
Polavaram (on the Godavari) has an FRL of 150 ft and a spillway of about 36 lakh cusecs.
Amaravati land was assembled through a participatory land-pooling model.
The World Bank backs the Amaravati Integrated Urban Development Program with a US$800 million loan.
AP is ruled by the NDA of TDP, JSP and BJP since June 2024.
'Super Six' is the set of flagship welfare guarantees of the NDA government.
Rythanna Meekosam, a farmer-empowerment programme, was launched on 24 November 2025.
Rythanna Meekosam rests on a Five-Point Formula (water security, demand-based cultivation, agri-tech, food processing, government support).
At its launch PM-Kisan Annadata Sukhibhava had paid over ₹3,200 crore to 68+ lakh farmers.
Free laptops to government employees is NOT a Super Six promise.
Free electricity to households is NOT a Rythanna Meekosam point.
Adabidda Nidhi is the Super Six women's financial assistance guarantee.
Rythanna Meekosam promised price support for tobacco, mango, onion and coconut.
AP topped FY26 (Apr-Dec 2025) proposed-investment rankings with about 25.3% share.
Odisha (13.1%) and Maharashtra (12.8%) followed; the top three held 51.2%.
The ranking came from a Bank of Baroda report (Jan 2026).
The 30th CII Partnership Summit (14-15 Nov 2025) at Visakhapatnam was inaugurated by Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan.
The summit theme was 'Technology, Trust, and Trade'.
It was organised with DPIIT and drew 2,500+ delegates from 77 countries.
Country-focus tracks were Russia, Japan, Saudi Arabia and Singapore.
The summit ended with 613 MoUs worth about ₹13,25,716 crore.
AP handles about 60% of India's marine-product exports.
That lead rests on its long coastline and large shrimp/aquaculture sector.
Summit priority sectors were green hydrogen, semiconductors and precision medicine.
The South Coast Railway zone became operational on 1 June 2026 with HQ at Visakhapatnam.
SCoR comprises the Guntakal, Guntur, Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam divisions.
Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram began commercial operations on 17 August 2026.
PM Modi inaugurated the Bhogapuram airport on 1 August 2026.
Commercial flights shifted there from the old Visakhapatnam airport.
The ₹5,640 crore Bhogapuram airport was built by GMR for 6 million passengers a year.
Projects worth ₹17,900 crore+ were dedicated in North Andhra on the airport day.
The Veligonda Project serves Prakasam, Nellore and Kadapa.
Veligonda was inaugurated on 31 Aug 2026, about 30 years after its foundation stone.
AP is building greenfield ports at Machilipatnam, Mulapeta and Ramayapatnam.
CM is N. Chandrababu Naidu (TDP) and Deputy CM is Pawan Kalyan (JSP).
The 4 April 2022 reorganisation raised AP districts from 13 to 26.
AP has 28 districts since 31 December 2025, adding Polavaram and Markapuram.
Polavaram district HQ is Rampachodavaram.
Madanapalle is the HQ of Annamayya district, not a separate district.
Kanigiri was among the new revenue divisions of 31 Dec 2025.
AP moved to 28 zilla parishads from 25 September 2026.
AP has 13,351 gram panchayats and 676 mandal parishads.
AP urban local bodies: 17 municipal corporations, 88 municipalities, 18 nagar panchayats.
AP covers 162,975 sq km, India's 7th-largest state.
About 8,140 sq km of AP is notified protected area.
AP's east coast is cyclone-prone.
Kadapa is the largest district in area and Visakhapatnam the smallest.
Nellore is the most populous district; Polavaram the least populous.
Pawan Kalyan was inducted into Japan's Takeda Shingen Clan as 'Tiger of Martial Arts' (Jan 2026).
He was the first Telugu-speaking inductee from outside Japan (Fifth Dan).
Garimella Balakrishna Prasad (posthumous, AP) got a Padma 2026 award in Art.
Gadde Babu Rajendra Prasad (AP) was also a Padma 2026 awardee in Art.
Surya Charishma Tamiri (AP) won women's singles at the 87th Senior National Badminton Championships, Vijayawada.
She beat Tanvi Patri in the final.
DRDO's NSTL, Visakhapatnam unveiled a man-portable autonomous underwater system (Nov 2025).
Visakhapatnam hosts the Eastern Naval Command and Hindustan Shipyard.
ISRO's spaceport SDSC-SHAR is at Sriharikota.
Sriharikota is a barrier island on the Bay of Bengal.
Dubbiganipalli was named among India's Best Village Panchayats (Nov 2025).
ASC ARJUN, Railways' first humanoid security robot, was deployed at Visakhapatnam station (Waltair Division) on 22 Jan 2026.
AP EDB and FLO agreed a 30-acre Women Entrepreneurs' Industrial Park (Jan 2026).
Reliance proposed a ₹2.73 lakh crore Underground Coal Gasification complex in Eluru district (Aug 2026).
UCG Phase 1 (2026-27) is exploration/pilot at about ₹3,000 crore.
INS Aridhaman, India's 3rd SSBN, was commissioned at Visakhapatnam on 3 April 2026.
INS Taragiri, the 5th Project 17A frigate, was commissioned at Visakhapatnam (Apr 2026).
Amaravati Quantum Valley 1S/1Q testbeds were inaugurated on World Quantum Day, 14 April 2026.
AP Budget 2026-27 was presented on 14 February 2026 by FM Payyavula Keshav.
Projected 2026-27 GSDP is ₹19,75,073 crore.
Fiscal deficit 3.8% and revenue deficit 1.1% of GSDP (2026-27).
Education, Sports, Arts & Culture got ₹35,673 crore, the largest listed head.
Dr NTR Vaidya Seva Trust got about ₹4,000 crore.
The Budget announced three City Economic Regions (CERs).
School Education got the highest departmental allocation (~₹32,308 crore).
The AP Budget 2026-27 outlay is ₹3,32,205 crore.
Annadata Sukhibhava was allotted ₹6,600 crore in 2026-27.
AP GSDP 2025-26 was about ₹17.62 trillion.
Economic Survey 2024-25 called AP the 'leading performer' in agriculture (~8.8% growth).
About ₹6,000 crore went to Amaravati in Budget 2026-27.
Thalliki Vandanam gives ₹15,000 a year per child via the mother and replaced Amma Vodi.
Annadata Sukhibhava = ₹20,000 a year (₹6,000 PM-KISAN + ₹14,000 State).
Annadata Sukhibhava replaced YSR Rythu Bharosa.
NTR Bharosa Pensions pay up to ₹15,000 a month to bedridden/CKD patients.
NTR Bharosa Pensions replaced YSR Pension Kanuka.
Deepam 2.0 gives 3 free LPG cylinders a year to about 1.08 crore households.
Stree Shakti free bus travel for women began on 15 August 2025.
Matsyakara Bharosa supports fishermen.
In July 2026 Thalliki Vandanam credited ₹10,120.78 crore to 42.70 lakh mothers.
Swarna Andhra @2047 rests on ten principles called 'Padi Sutralu'.
In P4, 'Margadarsis' (top 10%) support 'Bangaru Kutumbalu' (bottom 20%).
P4 stands for Public-Private-People Partnership.
P4 targets zero poverty by 2029.
Mana Mitra WhatsApp governance launched on 30 January 2025 and reached 700 services.
The RTGS was revived under IT Minister Nara Lokesh.
The Land Titling (Repeal) Act, 2024 repealed the 2022 Land Titling Act.
The Assigned Lands (Prohibition of Transfers) (Amendment) Act, 2026 is effective from 1 Dec 2025.
Four new police commissionerates (incl. Guntur, Kurnool, Rajamahendravaram) were approved in Sep 2026.
Cyclone Montha made landfall near Kakinada on 28-29 Oct 2025.
Montha affected about 1.8 million people in 249 mandals.
Ponduru Khadi (Srikakulam) got a GI tag (Dec 2025).
The Dec 2025 Cabinet ratified a ₹7,387 crore Amaravati loan, a 10% road cess and a DA hike.
In NITI Aayog's Fiscal Health Index 2026 Odisha is No.1 and AP is in the bottom five.
In the Investment Friendliness Index AP ranked 6th among large states.
Mar 2026: 50% one-time waiver of interest on property-tax arrears.
Google broke ground on a US$15 billion AI data-centre hub at Visakhapatnam (Apr 2026).
Justice Lisa Gill became the 5th Chief Justice of the AP High Court (25 Apr 2026).
May 2026: Omnibus Ease of Doing Business Act 2026 with a Pedestrian Safety Policy.
keys: Omnibus Ease of Doing Business Act

facts.fact: May 2026: 33.33% BC quota in ULBs plus direct election of Mayors approved.
The 16th Finance Commission gives AP local bodies ₹28,785 crore (2026-31).
Rules for direct election of Mayors/municipal chairpersons were issued (Jun 2026).
The State Election Commissioner is A. C. Punetha.
Sep 2026: revised ₹463.55 crore sanction for Handri-Neeva Sujala Sravanthi works.
Sep 2026: 815 Junior Assistant posts were approved.
The 4 June 2026 Cabinet cleared 34 proposals including a new aviation policy.
G. Sai Prasad became Chief Secretary from 1 March 2026.
Sai Prasad succeeded K. Vijayanand as Chief Secretary.
A. R. Anuradha (retd IPS) is APPSC Chairperson.
Anuradha succeeded Gautam Sawang as APPSC chair.
The Governor of AP is S. Abdul Nazeer (since 24 Feb 2023).
APPSC Group-1 Notification 07/2026 (6 Oct 2026) is for 166 vacancies; Screening on 24 January 2027.
Online applications close on 27 October 2026.
Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam is the largest tiger reserve in India.
Seshachalam is a biosphere reserve (2010), home of red sanders.
Coringa is a mangrove wildlife sanctuary near Kakinada.
Kolleru is AP's Ramsar site (2002).
President Droupadi Murmu reviewed the International Fleet Review 2026 off Visakhapatnam on 18 Feb 2026.
Exercise MILAN 2026 was held at Visakhapatnam alongside the IFR.
India took over the IONS chairmanship from Thailand at Visakhapatnam (20 Feb 2026).
A CSIR-NIO shore-based laboratory opened at Visakhapatnam on 30 Jan 2026.
NITI Aayog's ASSET blueprint (Feb 2026) aims to make AP a top-three renewable hub by 2035.
SRM University-AP set up India's first university-based Quantum Reference Facility (14 Apr 2026).
The AMCA fighter project complex foundation stone was laid at Puttaparthi (Sri Sathya Sai district) on 15 May 2026.
Kurnool is to host a 'Drone City'.
The first PM-SETU Strategic Investment Plan was approved for the Visakhapatnam ITI cluster (30 May 2026).
The AP Aviation Policy 2026-31 and the Amaravati Eye were cleared on 4 June 2026.
The CCEA approved Central Government General Pool Office Accommodation at Amaravati (10 Jun 2026).
A separate NCC State Directorate for AP was approved (15 Jun 2026).
VB-G RAM G was launched in AP at Mukkavaripalli, Tirupati district, on 2 Jul 2026.
Undavalli Heliport got India's first Point-in-Space (PinS) helicopter approach (Jul 2026).
INS Mahendragiri, the 6th Project 17A frigate, was commissioned at Visakhapatnam on 11 Jul 2026.
Skyroot's Vikram-1, India's first privately developed orbital-class rocket, lifted off from Sriharikota (18 Jul 2026).
PNB agreed to set up India's first bank-led Quantum Finance Hub at Amaravati (MoU 23 Jul 2026).
HSL delivered 'Nipun', the 2nd indigenous Diving Support Vessel, at Visakhapatnam (30 Jul 2026).
The Cabinet cleared ₹1,002.49 crore for the Quantum Valley Twin Towers (Aug 2026).
The BRICS Sports Ministers' Meeting at Visakhapatnam adopted the BRICS Sports Joint Declaration (23 Aug 2026).
IIT Tirupati hosted the BRICS working group on geospatial technology (20-23 Jul 2026).
Guntur Municipal Corporation won UNIDO's Gender Equality Mobilisation (GEM) award (2026).
AP added 3,865.63 MW of renewable capacity in 2025-26, about four times the previous year.
An IBM quantum computer is expected at Amaravati Quantum Valley in early 2027.
On 25 Sep 2026 the AP High Court disposed of the three-capitals petitions as infructuous.
The AP High Court struck down the 34% BC quota in local bodies on 1 Oct 2026 for breaching the 50% ceiling.
The Supreme Court dismissed AP's appeal against that order (9 Oct 2026).
Announced 14 Oct 2026: ULB polls 28 Oct, MPTC/ZPTC 3 Nov, gram panchayats 26 Nov-2 Dec 2026.
In Oct 2026 AP declared drought in 388 mandals across 21 districts (El Nino; 53% rain deficit).
The 7 Oct 2026 Cabinet approved a policy to attract foreign universities.
Polavaram crossed 90.1% physical progress (Oct 2026); major works target June 2027.
India has 103 Ramsar sites after Sukhna Lake and Sauj Jheel were added on 15 Oct 2026.
In Sep 2026 AP announced the 12th Pay Revision Commission with a DA release.
The Aug 2026 Cabinet approved the PPP Policy 2026 and withdrew the Disha Bill.
